newsitem.title: ITALY: Three Italians among survivors of Comoro plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Three Italians among survivors of Comoro plane crash.

text.p: Three Italians were among the survivors when a hijacked Ethiopian Airlines Boeing 767 crashed into the sea near the Comoro Islands on Saturday, ANSA news agency reported.

Two of the survivors, Massimo La Barbera and Caterina Urzi, both of them employed at the Italian embassy in Addis Ababa, swam to safety and came ashore close to a beach hotel, the agency said in a report from Nairobi. Neither was hurt.
La Barbera's mother said her son, who is an experienced skindiver, had called her in Italy after the crash to say that he was in good health, ANSA said.
A third Italian, Fabio Bedini, was treated for slight injuries at a hospital in Moroni, capital of the Indian ocean archipelago.
At least 50 people were killed when the airliner with 175 passengers on board ran out of fuel and ditched while trying to land at Moroni airport.
